title: Transcriptomic footprint of the lysine-pyruvylation regulatory network in diabetic foot ulcer tissue — reproduction package v1.0.0
description: Reproducibility package for a public-data re-analysis of the lysine-pyruvylation (Kpy) regulatory network in diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) tissue across 14 GEO series (10 analysed cohorts plus 3 bulk series inventoried but not processed at sample level, as documented in the manuscript limitations). The study integrates differential-expression meta-analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, a four-algorithm consensus machine-learning framework with external validation, immune deconvolution, single-cell and spatially resolved transcriptomics, cis-eQTL Mendelian randomisation and molecular docking with positive and negative controls. The package contains all analysis code, derived result tables, figures, manuscript text and a machine-readable audit ledger that traces every numeric claim in the manuscript to its source file. Kpy modification itself was not measured; all findings concern the transcriptional footprint of the Kpy regulatory network. MIT licensed.
